title: My Work Apps Stage an Intervention
shortDescription: Have Microsoft 365 Copilot write a funny Teams group chat in which your calendar, inbox, OneDrive, and Teams chat stage an intervention about your work habits.
longDescription: Ask Microsoft 365 Copilot to turn your own apps into characters: your calendar, inbox, OneDrive, and busiest Teams chat confront you in a short group chat about your work habits, each with a personality drawn from how you use it. With work grounding, available Work IQ context can personalize the response within your access permissions. The chat ends with one kind, practical suggestion; review the result before sharing.
